scope: Port official RadFoam initialization and full-view error maps into our custom fitting harness; paired native incremental and WarPower Morton geometry runs on the same NVIDIA L40.
timing_scope: Paired custom-loop timers include training, geometry updates, full-view densification, four evaluations, raw numerical audits, and midpoint checkpoint/restore. Exclude loading, native initialization bootstrap, setup, warmup, initial evaluation, and final serialization. The official-loop reference has a different batching/evaluation schedule and is used only for quality comparison.

traversal_cap_observation.meaning: Upstream trace increments its count then breaks when n > 1024, so this is a real cap stop. Audit counters cover warmup, training, error-map passes, evaluation and restore; exact phase/ray was not captured. Cause remains unresolved. Final held-out evaluation is separately clean.

post_measurement_fix: Current entrypoint additionally stores/restores the original initial-site count so later densification cadence survives checkpoint restoration. Full-recipe paired fits completed their last densification before step 10000, so this bookkeeping correction does not change their schedules. Their exact executed sources are retained; a separate 2000-step small-recipe regression exercises growth after restoration.
limitations: One full run per geometry backend; small PSNR differences do not establish systematic quality superiority.
One unlocalized traversal-cap hit in the WarPower audited run remains unresolved.
No claim of speedup over the differently scheduled official training loop, or reproduction of full-budget paper numbers.
Both backends use a one-time native initialization bootstrap to preserve upstream density/position associations exactly.
WarPower bounded adjacency and native full-hull triangulation have different contracts; previous exact geometry discrepancies are not resolved by this fitting result.
